description.source:
一位公開評論中的送修者，先選修理與配色，再把四年舊靴裝進鞋盒。收到收件通知後，用另一次授權維修示範與原廠現行說明，看拆底、車沿條、熱接和整理如何往前推進；最後接回那位送修者的完工消息、回程與新增鞋帶。公共評論保留未經獨立驗證的自述歸因；圖像是匿名概念插圖，示範與評論不是同一實鞋的證據。工序溫度只描述原廠現行接底操作。

description.text:
A customer in a public review first chose a repair and colours, then packed four-year-old boots in a shoebox. After the arrival notification, a separate authorised repair demonstration and the manufacturer's current explanations show how sole removal, welt stitching, heat welding and finishing move the work forward. We then return to that reviewer's account of completion, delivery and an extra set of laces. Public reviews remain attributed accounts that have not been independently verified. The images are anonymous conceptual illustrations; the demonstration and reviews do not establish that these are the same physical boots. The process temperature describes only the manufacturer's current sole-joining operation.

示範裡，師傅倒放靴子，刀沿鞋底上緣走。

一個噴口靠近露出的底層，師傅用布包住握鞋的手。
c7r20308: 鞋底朝上、靴筒朝下，他把上半部整個握在手裡，

c7r20313: 示範裡，靴子沿機針轉動，先接上新沿條；

c7r20320: 淺色的底層朝外，黑色鞋邊靠近機器；
新外底還沒接上，就先處理這一圈。
c7r20404: 你熟悉的氣墊，原廠在Original系列裡，
用鞋底的氣穴來解釋舒適和吸震。
c7r20410: 鏡頭裡，接合工具靠近鞋邊時，
邊緣透出橙紅的亮光，雙手仍扶在鞋身兩側。
c7r20411: 修鞋的人把靴子往另一個方向轉，
剛才朝著自己的那段鞋邊，又移到機器前。

c7r20514: 維修方說，修理會盡可能使用原廠部件；
其他替代材料，也要經品牌認可。

相同的方法、相同的材料，接回原來的構造。

原本敞開的鞋口，重新收回能穿的樣子。
c7r20601: 師傅把靴子收進紙箱，再把箱蓋折好；
拆修的示範，最後停在一個能寄走的包裹。
c7r20605: 這位送修者寫，從皇家郵政取走包裹起算，
一個星期後，快遞把鞋送了回來。
c7r20608: 我喜歡這個細節：主人送走的是一雙用過的鞋，
回來後連重新綁鞋帶，都有了新東西。
c7r20611: 那則評論寫，新底、沿條和縫線看起來很好，
像有了一雙新靴，卻不用重新忍受磨合。

c7r20619: 對那位七月評論者來說，這次想留下的上半部，

c7r20621: 訂閱品牌故事，我們繼續看熟悉的日用品，

lines.source: 你穿了四年的靴子，底快磨穿了，鞋面還好，現在會想留下哪一半？
lines.text: You've worn these boots for four years. The soles are almost worn through, but the uppers are still good. Which half would you want to keep?

lines.source: 二〇二五年七月，一位馬汀靴送修者在公開評論裡，寫下這個難題。
lines.text: In July 2025, someone sending their Dr. Martens for repair described this dilemma in a public review.

lines.source: 選修理時，對方還能挑鞋底和縫線的顏色，覺得很有趣。
lines.text: When choosing the repair, they could even pick the sole and stitching colours, which they found fun.

lines.source: 我想跟著它看：修理要拆到哪裡？
lines.text: I want to follow along and see: how far does the repair have to take them apart?

lines.source: 包裹回來時，又多了什麼？
lines.text: And what extra thing will be there when the parcel comes back?

lines.source: 我們就看這一雙馬汀靴，能不能把主人穿慣的鞋面留下來。
lines.text: Let's see whether this pair of Dr. Martens can keep the uppers their owner has worn in.

lines.source: 為了留下你穿慣的鞋面，換掉的到底會有哪些東西？
lines.text: To keep those familiar uppers, what exactly has to be replaced?

lines.source: 選項裡有一條沿條，可是它在鞋上的哪裡？
lines.text: One option mentions a welt. But where is it on the boot?

lines.source: 你順著鞋面往下看，鞋邊有一條繞著鞋身的帶子，上面可以看見縫線。
lines.text: Look down from the upper: a strip runs around the edge of the boot, with stitching visible on it.

lines.source: 維修方說，有沿條的鞋，會在這個部位露出細小的縫隙。
lines.text: The repair service says welted footwear has a small visible gap at this point.

lines.source: 從正上方看，鞋底邊緣還伸出比較寬的一圈，不跟鞋面完全齊平。
lines.text: Viewed straight down, the sole also sticks out in a wider rim, rather than sitting flush with the upper.

lines.source: 鞋邊那圈線，只是讓人一眼認出它的裝飾嗎？
lines.text: Is that ring of stitching just decoration that makes the boot recognisable?

lines.source: 我原先會把那圈線看成裝飾；近看才注意，它縫著一個真正的部件。
lines.text: I used to see it as decoration. Up close, I notice it stitches an actual component in place.

lines.source: 那條帶子叫做沿條，縫在鞋面下緣；網站把換底和換沿條列成同一項修理。
lines.text: That strip is called the welt, stitched to the lower edge of the upper. The website lists replacing the sole and welt as one repair.

lines.source: 要把這一雙交出去修，現在頁面標出的費用是多少？
lines.text: What does the page currently charge to send a pair in for this repair?

lines.source: 目前網站的經典換底加換沿條，標價是一雙七十九英鎊九十九便士。
lines.text: The website currently lists a classic resole and new welt at £79.99 per pair.

lines.source: 那位評論者則覺得，自己的這次修理，比另買一雙二手鞋還便宜。
lines.text: That reviewer, meanwhile, felt their own repair cost less than buying another second-hand pair.

lines.source: 鞋面還好，把靴口翻開，後跟內裡若已磨穿，要把外皮也換掉嗎？
lines.text: The upper is still good, but fold back the boot opening: if the heel lining has worn through, must the outer leather go too?

lines.source: 若後跟內裡已磨穿，維修方可以修補，或換上新的皮內裡。
lines.text: If the heel lining is worn through, the repair service can patch it or replace that lining with new leather.

lines.source: 照他們的說法，處理後跟內裡能恢復舒適，也減少上層鞋面進一步受磨。
lines.text: They say repairing the heel lining can restore comfort and reduce further wear on the upper.

lines.source: 星期四，對方把鞋放進舊鞋盒，印好郵寄標籤；隔天，郵差收走了盒子。
lines.text: On Thursday, the reviewer put the boots in an old shoebox and printed the postage label. The next day, the postman collected it.

lines.source: 鞋送出去，穿著者會先等到什麼消息？
lines.text: Once the boots are sent off, what news will the wearer receive first?

lines.source: 這位送修者說，維修方收到靴子後，先發來通知，鞋已經到站了。
lines.text: This customer says that when the repair service received the boots, it first sent a notification that they had arrived.

lines.source: 師傅手上的刀，會讓這雙靴子先少掉什麼？
lines.text: What will the repairer's knife remove from the boot first?

lines.source: 授權換底頁說，要先移走舊外底、沿條和縫線；示範裡，師傅倒放靴子，刀沿鞋底上緣走。
lines.text: The authorised resole page says the old outsole, welt and stitching are removed first. In the demonstration, the repairer holds a boot upside down and runs a knife along the top edge of the sole.

lines.source: 你還看得到鞋邊舊線，刀口沿著它附近前進，舊接合開始分開。
lines.text: You can still see the old stitching around the edge. The blade moves nearby, and the old join starts to separate.

lines.source: 接著，靴底已經露出內層，外面原本貼地的整塊底不在了。
lines.text: Next, the inner layers underneath the boot are exposed. The whole outer sole that used to touch the ground is gone.

lines.source: 我會盯著露出的接合位置：師傅接著會把這裡送向哪個工具？
lines.text: I'd watch the exposed joining area: which tool will the repairer take it to next?

lines.source: 鏡頭接著對準倒過來的靴底，一個噴口靠近露出的底層，師傅用布包住握鞋的手。
lines.text: The camera then points at the upturned bottom. A nozzle approaches the exposed layer, while the repairer wraps the hand holding the boot in cloth.

lines.source: 鞋底朝上、靴筒朝下，他把上半部整個握在手裡，沒有把皮面拆成一片片。
lines.text: Sole up and shaft down, the repairer holds the whole upper together, without taking the leather apart into separate pieces.

lines.source: 新外底要直接縫到鞋面上嗎？
lines.text: Will the new outsole be stitched straight onto the upper?

lines.source: 示範裡，靴子沿機針轉動，先接上新沿條；依原廠工法，這條帶子用的是聚氯乙烯。
lines.text: In the demonstration, the boot turns around the machine needle as the new welt is attached first. According to the manufacturer's method, that strip is made of polyvinyl chloride.

lines.source: 機器往前車，他的手也跟著調整位置，帶著這隻立體的靴子走過機針。
lines.text: As the machine stitches forward, the repairer's hands adjust, guiding the three-dimensional boot past the needle.

lines.source: 沿條車好，師傅再把靴底朝向修整工具，轉著鞋身處理邊緣。
lines.text: With the welt sewn on, the repairer turns the bottom towards a finishing tool and rotates the boot to work around the edge.

lines.source: 淺色的底層朝外，黑色鞋邊靠近機器；新外底還沒接上，就先處理這一圈。
lines.text: The pale underlayer faces out, and the black edge approaches the machine. This rim is worked on before the new outsole is attached.

lines.source: 它會怎麼接上去，讓這隻還露著底層的靴子重新能走路？
lines.text: How will it be joined so this boot, with its inner layers still exposed, can walk again?

lines.source: 輪到熱接了。師傅拿起新外底，放到已縫好沿條的鞋面下方。
lines.text: Now comes heat welding. The repairer takes the new outsole and positions it underneath the upper with its welt already stitched on.

lines.source: 公司說，今天多數外底用的是聚氯乙烯合金，也就是常叫PVC的塑膠。
lines.text: The company says most of today's outsoles use a polyvinyl chloride alloy: the plastic commonly called PVC.

lines.source: 一粒粒顆粒先熔融，再成型為鞋底，才有前掌、後跟和腳下的輪廓。
lines.text: Granules are melted and moulded into a sole, giving it a forefoot, a heel and the shape beneath your foot.

lines.source: 你熟悉的氣墊，原廠在Original系列裡，用鞋底的氣穴來解釋舒適和吸震。
lines.text: For the familiar air cushioning, the manufacturer describes air pockets in the soles of its Originals range as providing comfort and shock absorption.

lines.source: 他調整鞋底與鞋身的位置，讓這個新部件準備接到剛剛縫好的那圈邊。
lines.text: The repairer adjusts the positions of the sole and upper, ready to join this new part to the rim just stitched on.

lines.source: 我原先以為車線縫好就行，這裡卻改用熱刀；這道接底工序要多熱？
lines.text: I thought the stitching would be enough, but now a hot blade appears. How hot is this sole-joining operation?

lines.source: 原廠給這道接底工序的數字，是熱接溫度超過六百五十度。
lines.text: For this sole-joining operation, the manufacturer specifies a heat-welding temperature above 650 degrees.

lines.source: 熱刀加熱接合處，滾輪再把沿條和外底壓在一起。
lines.text: The hot blade heats the joint, then rollers press the welt and outsole together.

lines.source: 工具接觸鞋邊時，靴子的其他邊緣，要怎麼跟著送過去？
lines.text: As the tool touches the boot's edge, how are the other sections of the rim fed past it?

lines.source: 鏡頭裡，接合工具靠近鞋邊時，邊緣透出橙紅的亮光，雙手仍扶在鞋身兩側。
lines.text: In the footage, an orange-red glow shows at the edge as the joining tool approaches. Both hands still support the sides of the boot.

lines.source: 修鞋的人把靴子往另一個方向轉，剛才朝著自己的那段鞋邊，又移到機器前。
lines.text: The repairer turns the boot in another direction, bringing the section that faced them back towards the machine.

lines.source: 你從側面看，新底上緣貼近沿條，剛才分開的兩個部件，沿著邊緣合攏。
lines.text: From the side, you can see the new sole's top edge meet the welt. The two parts that were separate now come together around the rim.

lines.source: 拿開熱接工具之後，還得等什麼，才會接成一件？
lines.text: Once the heat-welding tool is removed, what must happen before the two become one piece?

lines.source: 原廠說，冷卻後，沿條與外底便形成一件PVC，鞋底就接好了。
lines.text: The manufacturer says that after cooling, the welt and outsole form a single piece of PVC, completing the sole joint.

lines.source: 這道接底程序沒有使用黏著劑，原廠把它寫成靠熱接完成的連接。
lines.text: No adhesive is used in this sole-joining operation; the manufacturer describes the connection as heat welded.

lines.source: 可是鞋接好了，新底邊緣還得怎麼處理，才輪得到鞋主人重新穿？
lines.text: But once the sole is joined, what must happen to its new edge before the owner can wear the boots again?

lines.source: 新外底的邊緣，先被師傅送到另一部機器前，沿著四周修整。
lines.text: The repairer first takes the new outsole's edge to another machine and works all around it.

lines.source: 他握著鞋身，讓鞋底沿著旋轉的工具移動，鞋子也跟著手腕換角度。
lines.text: Holding the upper, the repairer moves the sole along the rotating tool, changing the boot's angle with each movement of the wrist.

lines.source: 我覺得有意思的，是新底外緣正被修齊，上半部的使用痕跡卻還留著。
lines.text: What interests me is that the new sole's outer edge is being trimmed, while the signs of wear remain on the upper.

lines.source: 你想留下的舊鞋面，表面那些磨痕，又會怎麼處理？
lines.text: What happens to the scuffs on the old upper you wanted to keep?

lines.source: 師傅在工作檯前拿起布，沿著靴筒和鞋面擦拭，手也跟著鞋身移動。
lines.text: At the workbench, the repairer picks up a cloth and wipes along the shaft and upper, moving their hand around the boot.

lines.source: 布移過鞋身側邊，擦到已經彎折過的地方，原本灰暗的鞋面開始有了光澤。
lines.text: The cloth passes over the side and the places that have creased. The once-dull upper starts to shine.

lines.source: 維修方把清潔、補色和拋光，列成處理鞋面材料的服務，目標是盡可能恢復外觀。
lines.text: The repair service lists cleaning, colour restoration and polishing as treatments for upper materials, aiming to restore their appearance as far as possible.

lines.source: 要重做這道接合，維修方得備好哪些東西？
lines.text: What does the repair service need to have ready to remake this joint?

lines.source: 維修方說，修理會盡可能使用原廠部件；其他替代材料，也要經品牌認可。
lines.text: The service says it uses original parts wherever possible. Other replacement materials must also be approved by the brand.

lines.source: 年報說，修這種沿條與熱封的構造，需要專門的機器和技術。
lines.text: The annual report says repairing this welted and heat-sealed construction requires specialist machinery and skills.

lines.source: 授權維修方把自己的做法寫成相同的機器、相同的方法、相同的材料，接回原來的構造。
lines.text: The authorised repair service describes its approach as using the same machines, methods and materials to restore the original construction.

lines.source: 維修方把最後收尾稱為手工完成；你看師傅的手，接著又移到鞋的哪裡？
lines.text: The repair service calls the final finishing work hand done. Watch the repairer's hands: where on the boot do they go next?

lines.source: 示範裡，人的手接著轉向鞋帶孔，把黑色鞋帶一段一段重新穿回。
lines.text: In the demonstration, the hands move to the eyelets, threading the black laces back through one section at a time.

lines.source: 繩子穿過金屬孔，再跨到另一邊，原本敞開的鞋口，重新收回能穿的樣子。
lines.text: The lace goes through a metal eyelet and crosses to the other side. The opening that was spread apart takes on a wearable shape again.

lines.source: 鞋頭和靴筒整理好，師傅把一雙靴子擺回工作檯，旁邊換成了紙箱。
lines.text: With the toe and shaft tidied up, the repairer places a pair of boots back on the bench, with a cardboard box now beside them.

lines.source: 這雙鞋怎麼離開工作檯，重新回到送修的人手裡？
lines.text: How does this pair leave the bench and get back to the person who sent it in?

lines.source: 師傅把靴子收進紙箱，再把箱蓋折好；拆修的示範，最後停在一個能寄走的包裹。
lines.text: The repairer puts the boots into the box and folds the lid closed. The repair demonstration ends with a parcel ready to post.

lines.source: 七月那位送修者則寫，維修方收鞋後幾天，就通知鞋已修好，正在回程。
lines.text: The July reviewer writes that a few days after receiving the boots, the repair service notified them that the work was done and the boots were on their way back.

lines.source: 這位送修者寫，從皇家郵政取走包裹起算，一個星期後，快遞把鞋送了回來。
lines.text: This customer writes that, one week after Royal Mail collected the parcel, a courier delivered the boots back.

lines.source: 打開包裹，除了修好的鞋，你還會看見什麼？
lines.text: When you open the parcel, what will you see besides the repaired boots?

lines.source: 對方在評論裡稱讚接合和外底。
lines.text: The reviewer praises the join and the outsoles.

lines.source: 評論還特別提到，維修方多添了一組全新鞋帶。
lines.text: The review also specifically mentions an extra set of brand-new laces.

lines.source: 我喜歡這個細節：主人送走的是一雙用過的鞋，回來後連重新綁鞋帶，都有了新東西。
lines.text: I like that detail: the owner sent away a used pair of boots, and even tying them again now involves something new.

lines.source: 對方說，這次對修理和回程速度都很滿意，將來還願意再用這項服務。
lines.text: They say they were very happy with both the repair and the return time, and would use the service again.

lines.source: 另一位送修者在二〇二五年一月寫下，腳穿回去時，最滿意的是什麼？
lines.text: Another customer wrote in January 2025: when they put their feet back in, what pleased them most?

lines.source: 那則評論寫，新底、沿條和縫線看起來很好，像有了一雙新靴，卻不用重新忍受磨合。
lines.text: That review says the new soles, welts and stitching looked great: like having new boots without going through the break-in period again.

lines.source: 現在送修，網站預估要等多久？
lines.text: If you send boots in now, how long does the website estimate you'll wait?

lines.source: 目前網站預估最長約三週，這項服務只受理英國客戶。
lines.text: The website currently estimates up to about three weeks, and the service only accepts UK customers.

lines.source: 鞋回來以後，維修方還提醒，先清掉泥土，再按鞋面材料選保養品，定期重新照料。
lines.text: After the boots return, the repair service also advises removing dirt first, choosing care products for the upper material, and caring for them regularly.

lines.source: 對那位七月評論者來說，這次想留下的上半部，跟著修好的靴子一起回來了。
lines.text: For the July reviewer, the uppers they wanted to keep came home with the repaired boots.

lines.source: 如果是你，會把一雙穿出折痕的鞋留下來換底，還是重新穿一雙新鞋？留言告訴我。
lines.text: What about you: would you keep a creased, worn-in pair and replace the soles, or start wearing a new pair? Tell me in the comments.

lines.source: 訂閱品牌故事，我們繼續看熟悉的日用品，是怎麼被人做出、用過，再留在生活裡。
lines.text: Subscribe to Brand Stories, and we'll keep looking at how familiar everyday objects are made, used and kept in our lives.
